answer: Sequential-delay tickets: to register or renew, an agent must compute a verifiable delay function over a fresh epoch seed, about six hours of squarings that cannot be parallelized. Validators check the short proof in milliseconds and accept one ticket per seed per identity. Buying more hardware does not help, because each fake needs its own full run, so a farm of a thousand names burns a thousand machine-days per epoch, a ledge no bulk attacker can skip. Limit: faster custom chips shrink the delay, so the horizon must be recalibrated, and an idle ember of honest compute is spent.
